Blitz of Card - x64 Release

Default exhibit mode:
- Run "Blitz of Card.exe" or "Run-Fullscreen.bat".
- This starts fullscreen mode.

Fallback windowed mode:
- Run "Run-Windowed.bat".
- Use this if fullscreen has trouble on another PC.

Important:
- Set Windows default terminal application to Windows Console Host.
- Windows Terminal can show a black screen with this legacy console renderer.

Do not remove the Assets folder.
Target environment: 64-bit Windows.
